description: Publishes a new "What's New" post on the linked Google Business Profile location. It goes LIVE and PUBLIC immediately — there is no draft state and no undo here. Show the user the exact text and get their explicit approval before calling. Only standard posts are supported (no event, offer or alert fields).

languageCode.description: Language of the post. Defaults to en.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: create_gbp_post
